bio.text: Joe Krzeczkowski is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado's 7th Congressional District in the 2026 general election.

According to the campaign website, Krzeczkowski is a technology executive and software professional who grew up on a small family farm outside Ann Arbor, Michigan, and attended the University of Michigan Engineering School on a scholarship.
The site says Krzeczkowski moved to Colorado after graduating, has led global software teams and run small businesses, and lives in Lakewood, where a Community Council was led.
